what: What one mined rock contains. The finder says where a material is; this says what comes up with it.
percentages_are: shares of the rock's mass, rolled per spawn inside each band; the rest is inert. Confirmed against a real in-game scan of an iron rock.

source_meaning.surface: spawns from this body's own deposit table
